subject: English
title: 英文第三、1（3）題｜AI 人臉辨識與資料安全
question:
從下列選項選出最適合填入文章第（3）格的句子。

(A) Some apps let users take funny pictures with animal ears.
(B) Some apps stop working when your face is too close.
(C) Some apps help people draw pictures of their face.
(D) Some apps collect your face without telling you.
answer: (D) Some apps collect your face without telling you.
explanation:
第（3）格在資料安全段落。段首 Another problem is data safety 先點出主旨。後面說我們不知道記錄了什麼、資料怎麼用，並說有些人的臉部資料在本人不知情下已被儲存和分享。D 明確提出應用程式在未告知時收集臉部資料，順接段落主旨及後文。

(A) 加上動物耳朵是照片效果，無法自然引出後文的資料收集與使用。
(B) 臉靠太近導致軟體無法運作，是操作問題。
(C) 畫出臉部圖像是功能用途，沒有解釋後文為何談資料記錄和分享。
(D) 未告知就收集臉部資料，直接引出後文使用者不清楚資料如何記錄和使用。
trap: 空格前的 data safety 給主題，空格後的 recorded、used、saved 和 shared 可用來檢查選項有沒有承上啟下。
verificationNote: 已核對真正的使用者原卷、原作答及紅筆。日期依首次出題的台灣日期；原卷未提供足以確定冊次和章節的資訊，歸綜合。
passage:
The Risks Behind AI Face Recognition

AI face recognition is becoming more common in our lives. It helps us unlock phones, open doors, and even pay for things. But do you know the problems this technology brings?

One big problem is deepfake. _____ (1) _____ It is hard to tell what is real and what is not. In 2023, a company in China found that a man used deepfake to change his face and steal money from a friend’s account. _____ (2) _____

Another problem is data safety. _____ (3) _____ We don’t know what is being recorded or how the data is used. These are things that we should care about. Some people don’t even know that their faces have been saved and shared.

That is why we must learn how AI works, who can use our data, and what we can do to protect ourselves. Before we enjoy smart tools, we must ask whether they are safe and what risks we are taking.

panels.heading: 從段首抓主題
panels.text: 把文章的應用和風險分清楚。第（3）格在資料安全段落。
panels.alt: 手機顯示臉部辨識，箭頭通往人臉資料與安全盾。

panels.heading: 找空格後的線索
panels.text: 空格後談到資料如何被記錄、使用與分享。
panels.alt: 臉部辨識手機指向資料庫，再指出有些資料處理不為本人所知。

panels.heading: 比較功能與資料問題
panels.text: 趣味相片或繪圖用途無法解釋後文為何關心資料使用。
panels.alt: 動物耳朵相框和資料庫並排，區分趣味功能與資料收集。

fourth.answer: (D) Some apps collect your face without telling you.
points: D 的未告知收集臉部資料，順接段首 data safety 和下句被記錄、被使用的資料。
fourth.alt: 臉部辨識連到未告知的資料收集，再連回資料安全。
